description: Turns one voltage into sixteen fixed random voltages, on sixteen jacks and on one polyphonic jack

params.text: Alt mode: every voltage is snapped to 0V or to 10V, which turns the module into a random gate source

inputs.text: Sets the seed for the sixteen voltages, the same voltage always giving the same set; unpatched, the seed is one fixed built-in value, the same at every launch, not the random one the manual describes

outputs.text: All sixteen voltages together on one 16-channel cable
One of the sixteen voltages the seed generates, anywhere from 0V to 10V

notes: the voltages are regenerated a hundred times a second, so they change only when the seed voltage changes.

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads one fixed built-in seed.
